beats.say: A 744-billion-parameter model quantized to INT4 still weighs 429 gigabytes on disk — yet this test runs it on a laptop with no GPU.
Colibri streams the model from disk, and for smaller jobs a 30-billion-parameter coder runs entirely in RAM at about 10 tokens a second on CPU alone.
The giant earns its keep for air-gapped batch jobs and privacy-sensitive reviews, where waiting five minutes for an answer costs nothing.
